asset: Mario Teaches Typing title still and clean base
method: Deterministic crop and rectangular pixel replacement; no redraw, vectorization, thresholding, or per-pixel lettering mask.

source.copyright: The source's 1992 Interplay Productions and Nintendo copyright line is retained unchanged in title.png and title-base.png.

before.use: Supplies pixels only in baseReplacementRect; this earlier H.264 frame can differ from the final frame due to video compression.

baseReplacementRect.reason: Clean background rectangle with a small margin around subtitle and shadow; source and pre-letter frames share the same composition.

comparison.verification: title.png decodes pixel-identical to the source crop; title-base.png equals title.png outside the replacement rectangle and the pre-letter frame inside it.

outputs.src/assets/title/title-layout.json: Thirteen subtitle glyph rectangles and replacement geometry.

limitations: Video compression differences remain in the clean base because the source and pre-letter frame are from different moments of the same lossy video.

The rectangle is intended for a full-title reveal; per-letter reveal code can use title-layout.json glyph boxes. The background letters within it may show compression/timing differences during intermediate reveal states.
